mechanics: The function compares the incoming float with the zero-valued float at 0x01485378 using UCOMISS and returns without any port call for positive or negative zero.
For a nonzero or NaN input, it computes DAT_0169e398 + points in single precision.
It compares the cap DAT_01582e54 with the candidate using COMISS and stores the cap only when the ordered comparison is cap > candidate; there is no lower clamp.
It writes the selected four-byte result to DAT_0169e398 before resolving the player through 0x00b3d300 and 0x00f67d90.
It independently reads and writes the player float at +0x10f0 with the original points value, without applying the global cap.
It resolves the event gate through 0x00b5b800 and returns when the result equals the address of DAT_01654c10.
It resolves the action strategy through 0x00d38840 and returns when the strategy pointer is null.

For an active gate, it calls 0x00d2e2e0 on the strategy +0x68 receiver with the original float, resolves the noun manager and +0x54 avatar accessor again, and builds a 12-byte payload containing avatar, zero, and points.
It calls 0x00d39360 with action id 0x045ab96e and the payload pointer after the transition call; the return path restores ESI and deallocates the 0x1c local frame.

zero_sentinel.behavior: The target compares against exact zero, so +0.0 and -0.0 bypass all writes and calls; NaN is not equal to zero and follows the additive path.

global_state.cap_behavior: Only an upper cap is applied after addition; negative totals, positive and negative infinity, and unordered NaN comparisons are not clamped.
global_state.write_order: DAT_0169e398 is written before the manager/player lookup and before event gating.

player_state.cap_behavior: The player field is independent of DAT_0169e398 and is not capped.
